release_notes:
# Backplane v0.2.0 — strict Astral engineering baseline

This release records a coherent minor increment for mandatory Backplane-owned
Python engineering policy and its verified enforcement. The maintainer selected
0.2.0 and clarified that the version increment includes release publication.
There was no published 0.1.0; none is created retroactively. As the first
published snapshot, it also contains the existing native GitHub backlog and
handoff skills, independent Superpowers integration, native host packaging and
experimental OpenCode adapter. Historical acceptance retains its recorded scope.

## Delivered

- uv-managed Python 3.14.10 and locked project-local development/analysis tools.
- Mandatory Ruff lint/format, ty and unittest, four local pre-commit checks,
  and passing hosted Linux/macOS/Windows verification.
- Corrected active Python guide examples with routine syntax/lint/format guards.
- Complete applicable strict Astral acceptance, independently reviewed cognitive
  evidence, deeper analysis, 71-dependency audit with no known vulnerabilities,
  and actual guide-helper behavior coverage/mutation evidence.

## Contributor migration

Run `uv sync --locked --all-groups` and follow `docs/engineering/python.md`.
Use locked project commands in place of the former no-project commands.
Consumer projects retain their own language/runtime/tool policy.

## Scope and limitations

This is the verified engineering-baseline release, not acceptance of the complete
adoption arc in #1/#7. External pilot #6, operations acceptance #4 and remaining
OpenCode acceptance remain open. Historical Codex/Claude evidence retains its
original host/platform/source scope; this release does not claim a fresh native
host installation or complete four-host conformance. OpenCode remains experimental.
The first-adoption release obligations are deferred, not marked satisfied.
The maintainer owns the explicit release-specific scope disposition and initial
version departure; revisit them before claiming the complete adoption release.

Source: 0b18e34e65379e729d8fece97151a1bb8604b461
Exact-commit CI: https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/actions/runs/42414478313

Evidence: [release scope and authority](https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/0b18e34e65379e729d8fece97151a1bb8604b461/docs/superpowers-backplane/releases/2026-11-07-v0.2.0.md) and [strict acceptance](https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/0b18e34e65379e729d8fece97151a1bb8604b461/tests/scenarios/2026-11-07-strict-astral-full-verification.md).

## Objective

Give adopters clear legal terms and operational guidance for installing and maintaining Backplane.

## Bounded Scope

### Allowed

- An explicit human-approved repository license.
- README quick start and supported-scope statement.
- Installation prerequisites, update, rollback, uninstall, troubleshooting, and security-sensitive authorization guidance.

### Out of Scope

- Choosing a license without human approval.
- Claiming support for unverified harnesses.
- Replacing project-owned deployment or verification policy.

## Acceptance Criteria

- GitHub recognizes the approved license.
- The README accurately distinguishes supported, experimental, and out-of-scope surfaces.
- An adopter can follow the documented setup, update, rollback, and removal paths without undocumented maintainer knowledge.
- Documentation states that GitHub Projects and IssueOps are not required and no project runtime is imposed.

## Verification Seams

- Confirm `gh repo view` reports the intended license.
- Execute every documented command path in a clean adoption fixture.
- Review documentation against the approved v0.1 adoption contract and current compatibility evidence.

## Superpowers Artifacts

Design authority: human license selection plus the approved v0.1 adoption contract.

Approved implementation plan (operator approval 2026-11-01; unchanged blob 949e561175ab0bbde3ac72416dc0a3e6324239e7; consumed semantic revision 2026-08-23T13:55:22Z): https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/567892202e0f9d326ba375b2345d9615237174e3/docs/superpowers-backplane/plans/2026-11-01-issue-4-license-and-operations.md

Published partial implementation and execution evidence, directly integrated into main by operator selection: 567892202e0f9d326ba375b2345d9615237174e3.

Execution assessment (acceptance remains incomplete; no completed closure claimed): https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/567892202e0f9d326ba375b2345d9615237174e3/tests/scenarios/2026-11-01-issue-4-license-and-operations.md

The operator approved publication, immutable plan binding, main integration and cleanup on 2026-11-01. This artifact update preserves objective, bounded scope, criteria, verification seams and native graph. Product satisfaction and completed closure remain separate gates.

open_adoption_issue_observations.body:
## Objective

Validate v0.1.0 in a real adopting repository and capture fresh compatibility and conformance evidence.

## Bounded Scope

### Allowed

- One authorized pilot repository using the supported Codex installation surface.
- Current stable upstream Superpowers and current supported GitHub CLI capability surface.
- All five named Backplane conformance checks and fresh-session skill discovery.
- Capturing and resolving release-blocking pilot findings.

### Out of Scope

- Unapproved changes to the pilot repository's architecture, runtime, or release policy.
- Generalizing to additional agent harnesses.
- Waiving failed or unknown conformance results.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The authorized pilot installs Backplane without loss or overwrite of user work.
- Both required skills are discoverable in a fresh session.
- `skill-structure`, `native-issue-intake`, `language-neutral-verification`, `lifecycle-transitions`, and `superpowers-installation` all pass.
- Release-blocking findings are resolved or represented by native blockers.
- Durable evidence records revisions, CLI capability results, skill hashes, prompts, and scored outcomes.

## Verification Seams

- Execute the complete compatibility preflight and conformance protocol in `skills/managing-superpowers-backlog/references/installing-superpowers.md`.
- Re-read the pilot issue graph and verify no unresolved blockers remain.
- Confirm evidence was produced from the installed candidate rather than the authoring checkout.

## Superpowers Artifacts

Design authority: the approved v0.1 adoption contract and installation design.

Plan: not yet created.

## Objective

Review, tag, and publish Backplane v0.1.0 only after the integrated release candidate satisfies its adoption contract.

## Bounded Scope

### Allowed

- Final review and branch-finishing workflow.
- Fresh integrated verification, release notes, version tag, and GitHub release publication.
- Accurate documentation of supported and unsupported surfaces.

### Out of Scope

- Adding unrelated features during release preparation.
- Publishing with unresolved native blockers or unknown conformance results.
- Claiming support beyond the verified v0.1.0 contract.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Every blocking release issue is closed as completed with integration and fresh verification evidence.
- The integrated target is clean, reviewed, and passes the exact release verification commands.
- License, adopter documentation, compatibility baseline, and limitations are accurate.
- GitHub exposes the intended v0.1.0 tag and release.

## Verification Seams

- Re-fetch this issue and every native blocker immediately before release.
- Run the full project-owned verification suite on the integrated target and record zero failures.
- Verify the published tag resolves to the reviewed commit and the release assets and notes match it.

## Superpowers Artifacts

Design authority: approved v0.1 adoption and release contract.

Plan: not yet created.
